payload.title: The tenant role editor saves capabilities under display names: permissionCategories drops the resource key, PermissionCheckboxGroup keys the panel by resource.name, and the server turns that into strings such as HR Finance:view_salary, which the catalogue whitelist rejects
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/resolvers/tenant-role.resolver.ts:143-146 (resource key discarded; only display name and actions returned)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/permission-catalogue.ts:145-159 (wire capability built as panel key plus action)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/capability-authority.ts:217-223 (any string outside the catalogue is rejected)
payload.rule_violated: Plan PKG-03 goal (the role editor stores keys, not display names) and the catalogue contract that the wire form of a capability is resource-key:action
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-03, release R2.
